name: haoban
description: Read quotes, invoices, customers, projects, payments, reports and calendars in Haoban, prepare quote and invoice drafts, and keep customers, projects, to-dos and events up to date.

interface.longDescription:
Haoban is a quoting, invoicing and payment workspace for small businesses in Taiwan. Connect it to ask about your business in plain language and turn requests into drafts, to-dos and events.

What you can do:
- Find quotes, invoices, customers, projects and payments by name or number.
- See which invoices are overdue and how much is still outstanding.
- Get revenue and receivables summaries for a period.
- Create and update customers and projects, and mark projects complete.
- Add to-dos and calendar events, reschedule them, assign them to teammates and mark to-dos done.
- Create or edit quote and invoice drafts. Each draft comes with a link so you can check it in Haoban.

What stays in Haoban:
Publishing or sending documents, recording payments, voiding, issuing e-invoices and changing company settings are only done by you in Haoban. Nothing is ever deleted, archived or cancelled through this plugin.

Sign in with your Haoban account. The plugin has the same permissions as your role in each company: viewers can only read, and finance members cannot create quotes. You can revoke access at any time under Settings › Connect AI in Haoban.
defaultPrompt: Which invoices are overdue in Haoban?
Draft a quote in Haoban for my latest customer.

positive.description: Find overdue invoices and the outstanding amount
positive.prompt: Which invoices in Haoban are overdue, and how much is still outstanding?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the overdue invoice for Island Creative Ltd. with its due date and the unpaid amount, using data from the Haoban Demo Studio company.

positive.prompt: Show me the contact details for Island Creative in Haoban.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the customer Island Creative Ltd. and shows its contact person, email and phone.

positive.description: Create a to-do and mark it done
positive.prompt: In Haoban, add a to-do to call Mori Living about the brand guidelines quote, due next Friday. Then mark it as done.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a to-do in the Haoban Demo Studio company with next Friday as the due date, then marks the same to-do as done and keeps its title and due date. Returns a link to the to-do in Haoban.

positive.description: Create a quote draft without publishing it
positive.prompt: In Haoban, draft a quote for Mori Living: brand guidelines design, 1 set at NT$45,000.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft quote for Mori Living with one line item of NT$45,000 plus 5% tax, does not publish or send it, and returns a link to review the draft in Haoban.

positive.prompt: What payments did we receive in Haoban this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the payments recorded this month with the customer, amount and date.

negative.description: Refuses to send a document by email
negative.prompt: Email the overdue invoice to Island Creative now.
Delete the customer Harbor Coffee from Haoban.
Mark the Island Creative invoice as paid in Haoban.

publication.release_notes: First release: read quotes, invoices, customers, projects, payments, reports, calendar and to-dos; create and update customers, projects, to-dos and calendar events, and mark to-dos done; create or edit quote and invoice drafts.

zh-TW.subtitle: 報價、請款與收款
zh-TW.description:
好辦是台灣中小企業的報價、請款與收款工作區。連接後可以直接在對話裡查詢與整理好辦的資料，把需求整理成草稿、待辦與行程。

可以做的事：
- 以名稱或編號找報價單、請款單、客戶、專案與收款紀錄。
- 查看哪些請款逾期、還有多少未收。
- 讀取一段期間的營收與應收報表。
- 建立與修改客戶、專案，將專案標記完成。
- 新增待辦與行程、改期、指派給同事，並把待辦標記完成。
- 建立或修改報價單與請款單的草稿，並附上好辦的網址讓你檢查。

留在好辦完成的事：
發布或寄送文件、登錄收款、作廢、開立電子發票與修改公司設定，都要你在好辦操作；這個外掛不會刪除、封存或取消任何資料。

以你的好辦帳號登入，權限與你在各公司的角色相同。隨時可以在好辦的「設定 › 連接 AI」撤銷授權。
